title: Low-poly rock cluster (Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ) that procedurally generates: Generate a cluster of 4-8 low-poly rocks, each built by perturbing an icosahedron's vertices along their normals with seeded random noise (breaking the perfect-sphere look), then placed at randomized (seeded) positions, rotations, and scales so they form a natural-looking cluster without overlapping at the cluster center. Save to obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
